text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Expected years of schooling among girls by education level
For each year, this shows how many years girls starting school then can expect to spend at each education level
if current enrollment patterns stay the same. It includes repeated grades.
